tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// smon lam gyi rim pa tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rigs drug khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// dkon mchog rnam gsum dam can srung mar bcas// bden tshig grub pa rnams kyi bden stobs kyis// tshe dang ldan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi// gnas skabs mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad bdud// nad gdon dbul phongs la sogs kun bral zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags sogs// mthun pa'i phyogs kun dkar phyogs zla ba bzhin// gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig /gzhi yi gnas lugs gshis babs gnyug ma nyid// cis kyang bsgyur du med pa ngo bo'i gnad// gnas skabs lam du tha mal lus kyi rtsa// rlung dang thig le gdod nas yongs grub pa'i| |bde chen khrag 'thung rdo rje nyid gyur cing*// las rlung rdo rje'i bzlas par rab dag nas// dman pa'i gtum mo bde drod rab 'bar zhing*// mchog gi gtum mo lhan skyes rang ngo mthong*// gzhi yi 'od gsal gsal stong 'dzin bral sems// lam dus gnyid 'thug chos sku'i rang mdangs gsal| |'chi tshe 'od gsal ngo 'phrod ma bu 'dres// nying 'khrul rmi lam gnas skabs 'dzin sbyang spel// sprul sgyur zhing sbyong mthar thug sku gsum mthong*// dag dang ma dag sgyu ma'i dpe don gyis// 'khor 'das chos kun snang stong la sogs pa// tshogs drug 'dzin pa sgyu ma'i ngang du grol// mchog gi sgyu lus stong gsal chos sku dngos// gnas skabs rlung sngags lha yi sbyor ba yi// 'pho bas rtsol med dag pa'i lus 'khrugs shing*// mchog gi 'pho ba 'pho bya 'pho byed bral// rnam shes bla ma 'od gsal klong du 'byams// rang sems mtha' bral ma rtogs rtsol bcas kyi// zhi lhag sbyor bas rang ngo rang gis shes// ngo bo bskyangs pas 'khrul gzhi rtsad nas chod// 'khor 'das rgyab gyes rtse gcig ngo bo rtogs// gzung 'dzin mtshan rtog spros bral dbyings su dag

/'khor 'das du mar snang yang ro gcig gyur// spros pa'i mtha' zad ci yang bsgom du med// de tshe med bzhin rten cing 'brel 'byung gi// chos sku'i ngang las nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin// rtog med 'gro blo dag par nges pa lnga// ldan pa'i longs sku skal med rnams kyi ngor// dag dang ma dag sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// 'khor mtha' ma zad bar du mi 'dzad pa'i// rnam rol smon lam thugs bskyed mthu las byung*// de yi bstan pa yun du gnas la sogs// don gnyis lhun grub dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang mnga' ris dpon btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis phyag chen chos drug gnyis ka dang 'brel ba'i smon lam zhig dgos zer bar/ shākya'i dge slong 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pa don dam zung 'jug gi gtum mo la dbang 'byor pas ras rkyang dang gcer bu'i brtul zhugs dang bral/ gnas lugs mchog gi 'od gsal rtogs pas gnyid 'thug gi brgyal thabs la bdag 'dzin ma shes/ don dam sgyu ma'i rang mtshang mthong bas me long dang lha sku'i ngos la lta ba'i spros pa chad/ bar dor 'khrul 'jigs kyi dogs ma dgos pas tshe 'dir 'chi smon gyi bar do sbyang rgyu med/ gnas lugs thams cad chos skur grol bas nying 'khrul rmi lam la bdag 'dzin gyi skal ba chad| don dam mchog gi 'pho ba spros pas stong pa'i phaṭa hika 'jag ma'i bcos ma ha ma go// yin lugs gnyug ma rang thag chod pas dran 'dzin dang gnyen po had sgom nag po kha 'byams kyi rbad kham ma thon/ rang lus gdod nas lha skur yongs su grub pas mngon rtogs 'og 'gyu'i gshar sbyang ma shes/ rlung sngags dbyer med rdo rje'i bzlas par song bas bgrang phreng dang mchu mug 'don zlos med pa'i skal chad zog po bag yangs pa/ mdor na chos thams cad spros bral rang rig rang mthong rang grol las spros pa'i gtad so gang yang med pa nga 'dra bas bris pa yin no ang*/// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhing khams mtha' yas par// 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung dang*// lha mi'i drang srong bden tshig grub rnams kyis// rnam dag smon lam 'grub pa'i bden pa stsol// bdag sogs mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// ngan song gsum dang lha min lha la sogs// byang chub sgrub las gol ba'i lus spangs te// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar// dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ldan pa'i// skyon med mi lus dam pa thob gyur cig /de rnyed nas kyang gnas dang grogs la sogs// mi dge sdig la spyod pa'i gzhan dbang du// rnam pa kun tu ma gyur de las gzhan// thub bstan yongs su dag pa'i sgor 'jug cing*// lam gyi rtsa ba mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i// dam pa rnams ni mnyes bzhin bsten nas kyang*// bstan rtsa 'dul ba'i khrims kyis rgyud sbyangs shing*// nyes med phun tshogs tshul khrims nor gyis phyug /mang thos don ldan bsam dang don bsgom pa'i// 'khor lo gnyis la 'bad cing sgrub gyur cig /byang chub sgrub pa'i rtsa ba sa bon nyid// smon 'jug sems gnyis rtag tu goms byas shing*// de yi bslab bya ma lus ji bzhin du// 'bad pas srung zhing bslab gzhi kun 'dzin gyur// tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gcig pu// zla bral smin lam chu bos rgyud sbyangs shing*// de don mtshan nyid kun tshang bskyed pa'i rim// skye gnas bzhi sbyong lam gyi mchog grub cing*// bzlas brjod mthar phyin grub pa mchog thob shog /gang yang srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i thabs// steng 'og rnam grol rdzogs pa'i rim pa mchog /mtshan mar bcas dang mtshan ma las 'das pa'i| |zung 'jug bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'gros mthar phyin// dngos kun sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rnam rol du// 'char ba'i ting 'dzin mchog la rab gzhol zhing*// yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang po'i// go 'phang thob nas gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyis// 'gro ba'i don kun 'bad med 'grub gyur cig

/de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu bdag /dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi grags pa nyid// dag pa'i zhing mchog gang du 'tsho gzhes kyang*// de dang mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ltar// rtag tu zhabs brtan mnyes pa rnam gsum gyis// thugs kyi dgyes skong de dang skal mnyam zhing*// de yi bstan pa'i chos mdzod ma lus pa// 'dzin dang spel ba'i bdag po nyid gyur nas// rnam pa kun tu dge bas 'tsho gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma yi dam lha/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa'i bden stobs kyis// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i legs smon 'di// gegs med myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'ang dge slong dkon mchog rab brtan gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang lo re gcig pa shing lug zla ba bdun pa'i dmar po'i stong pa gnyis pa la/ 'bri klung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par sbyar ba dag go/// /sid+dhi rastu// ༈ /gang gi rten 'byung rig pa'i gshis babs kyi// rang bzhin rnam dag khams kyi dge tshogs dang*// byas bsags dus gsum bsags yod dge ba'i mthus// smon lam rnam dag stobs kyis bsngos pa dang*// mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// chos skyong dam can drang srong bden pa'i tshig /ji bzhin grub pa rnams kyi mthu byin gyis// bdag sogs 'gro rnams tshe 'dir nad gdon bgegs// bar chad chos min 'tshe ba kun bral zhing*// tshe dpal 'byor pa mthun phyogs ji snyed pa// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// bsam don dam pa'i chos bzhin rab grub nas// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob shog /ces pa'ang rnam grol gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ sa byi zla ba drug pa'i gnam gang la rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa sarba swa sti maṅga laṃ kurban+tu/// /

༈ /bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas rnams dang*// sangs rgyas chos tshogs dam can sogs// bslu med rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus// bdag dang mar gyur lus can rnams// rnam pa kun tu nad gdon dang*// nye bar 'tshe ba yongs bral zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor sogs// 'dod dgu lhun gyis rab grub cing*// 'di dang phyi ma kun bde ba'i// dam pa'i chos la longs spyad nas// de 'bras don gnyis 'bad med du// grub pa rdo rje 'chang dbang po'i// go 'phang bde blag thob par shog /ces pa'ang dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ sa byi zla ba drug pa'i gnam gang la rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa swa sti pra dze bh+yaḥ ༈ /rtsa gsum dam can srung ma'i byin rlabs dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i smon lam mthus// mar gyur nam mkha'i khams mnyam 'gro ba kun// rtag tu sdug bsngal nyer 'tshe kun bral zhing*// rdzogs ldan dpal la 'gran pa'i bde thob nas// kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa'ang dge slong ljang rnyed kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos gyi grags pas/ me pho spre'u zla ba'i yar tshes bcu la gnas chen ti sgro'i dben gnas 'brong ngur sum mdo'i bsam gtan khang bur bris pa'o/// / ༈ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*// bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i mthus// rin chen shes rab nad gdon bar gcod tshogs// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor longs spyod rab rgyas shing*// bsam don 'bad med chos bzhin myur 'grub nas// tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang nas kyang*// don gnyis lhun grub rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /ces pa'ang tha ba kha'i mtshams pa rin chen shes rab kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas mgyogs par bris pa'o/// /

༈ /sras bcas rgyal dang rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung*// chos dang tshogs bcas yi dam srung ma'i mthus// tshe dang ldan pa phun tshogs dbang po yi// nad gdon 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs// mthun pa'i phyogs kun dbyar gyi nyal 'gro ltar// ches cher rgyas shing 'phel ba nyid gyur nas// phyi ma don gnyis lhun grub byang chub che// rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces pa'ang rnam sras gling nas sprul pa'i sku dang*/ sde pa yab sras kyis smon lam dgos gsungs par/ dbu ru byang phyogs 'bri chos phyug gi klung du son pa skyu ra'i gdung las dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ /chos mdzad gad la 'or par gnang ba/ sangs rgyas tshos tshogs rtsa gsum srung ma yi// mi bslu bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag kun// dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi grags pa yis// tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral rjes 'dzin cing*// khyod kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo ba legs thob nas// de 'bras don gnyis grub pa'i go 'phang mchog /myur du thob pa'i smon lam 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'ang chos mdzad rin chen phan bdes bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ me pho spre'u zla ba'i yar tshes bcu la gnas chen mi 'gyur ti sgro'i dben gnas 'brong ngur sum mdor bris pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sangs rgyas sku dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen yi dam lha tshogs dang*| |mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis// bdag sogs deng nas byang chub ma thob bar// nad gdon bar gcod 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs// thams cad mkha' la sprin ltar rab zhi zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor la sogs pa// mthun pa'i phyogs kun rab tu 'phel ba dang*// bsam don 'bad med chos bzhin rab grub nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog thob shog

/ces pa'ang lcang gcig sde pa mgon pos bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ gzho stod gter sgrom brag dkar gyi gnas 'dabs dben gnas 'brong ngur sum mdor bris pa'o/// / ༈ /rgyal ba sras bcas chos dang 'dus pa'i tshogs// rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs kyis// kun dga' shes rab ces pa'i nad gdon bgegs// 'tshe ba rnams bral tshe bsod rgyas pa dang*// bsam don chos ltar grub nas mthar thug tshe// don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs byang thob par shog /ces pa'ang dge slong kun dga' shes rab kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas dbur stod rtse ba gzhis kar bris/// / ༈ bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas yum dang bcas// sangs rgyas chos tshogs srung ma'i bden mthu yis// sngags pa dbang drag ces bya'i nad gdon bgegs// zhi bas dbyung dang drag pos tshar gcod cing*// tshe bsod rab rgyas bsam don lhun grub nas// rang sems ka dag yon tan lhun grub pa// blo 'das khregs chod rang mdangs thod rgal lam// snang bzhi ye shes chen po mthar son nas// sku dang ye shes rdzogs pa'i kun tu bzang*// gzhi gnas gdod ma'i sa la phyin par smon// zhes pa'ang sngags pa dbang drag gis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa rgyal sras dbur smyon zhes pas/ rtse ba gzhis kar mgyogs par bris so/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dang*| |yod pa'i khams dge mi zad pa// de yi tshogs rnam bzlums pa'i stobs// don gnyis 'grub la bdag smon no// zhes pa phun tshogs bzang pos bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos grags kyis bris/// / ༈ /bden pa gang zhig rang gshis babs kyi gnad// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'byung 'brel ba'i mthus// dkon mchog tshe ring 'tshe ba las rgyal nas// bla med byang chub snying po la reg shog

|ces pa'ang chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /rgyal ba kun dang brtse ldan tshogs// lha dang srung ma'i bden pa yis// phrin las dbang po zhes bya ba'i// bsam don chos bzhin myur 'grub cig /ces pa'ang 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /bslu med rgyu 'bras gshis babs kyi// bden pa yang dag de yi mthus// dkon mchog don grub ces bya ba// bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces pa'ang chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis// bsam gtan zhes pa'i nyer 'tshe rnams// zhi nas mthun rkyen kun 'grub cing*| |rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa'ang 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /lha dang bla ma chos skyong rgya mtsho yi// phrin las mi zad mnga' ba de yi mthus// dkon mchog ngag dbang 'tshe ba kun bral nas// shākya'i gtso bo de dang 'dra bar shog /ces pa'ang 'bri rgan chos grags kyi bris/// / ༈ /bslu med skyabs gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma'i bden stobs kyis// rnam grol tshe ring 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas// phyi ma rdo rje 'chang dbang sa thob shog /ces pa'ang rnam grol gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa dge slong chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang de sras brtse ldan tshogs// yi dam chos skyong mchog gsum bden pa'i mthus// rin chen blo gros tshe 'di'i 'gal ba'i rkyen// bar chad nyer 'tshe'i tshogs las rab rgyal zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar ngo ltar 'phel nas// don gnyis lhun grub go 'phang grub nas kyang*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng bar shog /ces so// sku bad kyi snyun gzhi la brtag pa dgos tshul mdzad 'dug par/ brtag pa 'tshub cha che ba ni ma byung zhing*/ 'phral rkyen ni ri brag rtsub po shing nags yod pa'i 'dabs su bzhugs zhag gi tshe mi gtsang ba'i zas gos dang*|

yul gyi gzhi bdag khros pa'i rgyus bslang ba zhig 'dug pas// lha bsang dang zab khrus/ grib sel/ yul lha gsol mchod sogs mdzad na phan par mchi/ zhes zur mang chos rjes gser gyi me tog dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas bris pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /skyabs mchog rnam gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam chos skyong rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid// rtsa ba'i bla ma chos kyi grags pa yi// zhabs la gus pa mchog gis gsol btab mthus// bdag sogs 'khor bar 'phyan pa'i 'gro tshogs rnams// zad med sdug bsngal rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas// gtan nas bcom zhing rnam par grol ba'i lam// rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos la spyod gyur cig /nam zhig khyod kyis rdo rje'i gdan bzang por// rgyal ba me tog lang tsho ngom pa'i tshe// bdag kyang 'dus pa'i dang por rab skyes nas// don gnyis grub pa'i bdud rtsi'i bgo skal gyi// thog ma nyid kyi pha 'bab rab thob nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /ces pa'ang dge slong ye shes phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
